children: Ethereum remains vulnerable to institutional selling pressure, persistent U.S. inflation and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve's future monetary policy, Zaye Capital Markets analyst Naeem Aslam says in a note. "Recent price volatility highlights the cryptocurrency's sensitivity to broader financial conditions, particularly when elevated borrowing costs encourage investors to reduce exposure to speculative assets." Ethereum exchange-traded funds have suffered outflows in recent sessions. A recovery in the cryptocurrency depends on whether institutional ETF withdrawals moderate and verifiable ethereum accumulation strengthens alongside improving global liquidity conditions, he says. Ethereum falls 0.1% to $2,449, having reached an eight-week low of $2,322 Thursday, LSEG data show. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
